# Liffio

> Liffio is an Instagram DM automation platform with chatbots. It sends automatic direct messages via Instagram's official API when someone comments on a post, and its chatbots hold full conversations inside the DM. DMs are unlimited on every plan, Free included.

## What Liffio does

Liffio connects to Instagram via official OAuth, with no passwords stored. After authorization, you set up automation rules called "flows." Each flow watches for a specific trigger (a comment keyword or a story reply) and sends a personalized DM.

## Automation types

- Comment-to-DM: someone comments a keyword on a post or Reel → they receive a DM automatically
- Story reply automation: someone replies to or mentions a story → they receive a DM
- DM reply automation: someone sends a DM keyword → they receive a reply
- Ask Follow (follow gate): user must follow before receiving a promised resource
- Follow-up sequences: scheduled follow-up messages within an active conversation
- Collect Data: capture email addresses shared in DM conversations and store them as leads

## Chatbots

Chatbots are a separate module from comment to DM automation. A simple comment to DM automation needs no flow builder; a chatbot is for a full conversation inside the DM.

- Free: build and publish chatbots, manage contacts, link buttons, chat analytics. 2 live chatbots, 15 steps and 5 keywords per bot, 500 chatbot conversations a month
- Starter: adds questions, conditions, media messages, personalization, follow-ups inside a chat, a follow gate, and turning off chatbot branding. 5 live chatbots, 40 steps and 15 keywords per bot, 1 follow-up per step
- Growth: adds ice breakers, story reply and story mention triggers, a default reply for unmatched DMs, chain bots, templates, tags, and starting a chatbot from a comment. 15 live chatbots, 100 steps and 40 keywords per bot, 2 follow-ups per step
- Business: adds lead capture into the leads list, a webhook step, A/B testing on a step, handover routing, business hours and a notify step. Unlimited live chatbots, steps and keywords, 3 follow-ups per step
- Agency: the same as Business in each of its 20 workspaces
- Every plan: up to 13 buttons per step, which is Instagram's own limit

## Pricing (USD, billed monthly)

DMs are unlimited on every plan, Free included.

- Free: $0/month: unlimited DMs, 3 automation workflows, keyword and any comment triggers, public auto reply, 2 live chatbots, bio link page and short links, leads list, overview analytics, 1 team member
- Starter: $9/month ($7.50/month billed annually): Liffio branding off, trigger blocks, follow before DM, 25 automations with 2 follow-ups each, 5 live chatbots with questions, conditions, media and personalization, lead export, 30 day analytics history, API access (200 requests a day, 5 keys), 3 team members
- Growth: $29/month ($24.17/month billed annually): ice breakers, story reply and story mention triggers, default reply, 15 live chatbots with chain bots, templates and tags, start a chatbot from a comment, post, video and profile metrics with 90 day history, caption and schedule templates, hashtag groups, bulk upload, 100 automations with 5 follow-ups each, 5 team members
- Business: $59/month ($49.17/month billed annually): chatbot lead capture, webhook step, A/B testing on chatbot steps, handover routing and business hours, unlimited live chatbots, post approvals and activity log, per person permissions for up to 15 team members, analytics export and per automation attribution, 250 automations with 10 follow-ups each
- Agency: $549/month ($457.50/month billed annually): 20 workspaces, each a complete Business workspace, on one subscription with one invoice and one renewal date, agency branding and hide Liffio branding, client workspaces, and every limit per workspace

Annual billing charges 10 months instead of 12, so two months are free.

US dollar prices are billed as an export. No Indian GST applies. Prices shown in rupees include GST, so the amount shown is the amount charged, and a GST tax invoice is issued for every payment.

India pricing available via Razorpay in INR, incl. GST: Free ₹0, Starter ₹499, Growth ₹1,499, Business ₹2,499, Agency ₹22,999 per month. Every plan connects one Instagram account per workspace (Agency includes 20 workspaces). Every plan, Free included, includes unlimited automated DMs and chatbots.

## Key facts

- Founded: 2026
- Team: 5 co-founders: Shivam (CEO), Om (CTO), Vishal (CMO), Shlok (CFO), Pratham (CRO)
- Location: India
- Instagram connection: official Instagram API via Meta's OAuth consent flow (no password required, no scraping)
- Send delays: 10 to 60 seconds per automation (configurable)
- Data: GDPR-compliant, contact data exportable and deletable from dashboard
- Payment: Razorpay (USD global and INR India)
- Competing tools: ManyChat, SendDM, Chatfuel, ReplyRush, LinkDM, SuperProfile, InstaChamp, Zorcha
